predeclaration.exploratory_gate_seed42: An arm passes the seed-42 gate if at ckpt 6000 the macro-F1 delta vs baseline is > 0 for at least one (feature, dataset) pair. Only then are seeds 43 and 44 launched.
predeclaration.success_rule: Success if, for one primary feature, the macro-F1 delta (arm minus fresh same-environment baseline) has the same positive sign in seeds 42, 43 and 44 on one dataset, AND the other dataset does not worsen by more than 0.01 macro-F1 in any of those seeds. Same rule as Phase A (queue4096 used the same wording).
predeclaration.failure_rule: Anything else is not success. Checkpoints 2000 and 4000 and the per-endpoint clinical numbers are descriptive only and do not enter the rule.
predeclaration.multiplicity: Hypothesis count per coordinator and statistical review: one hypothesis = one arm with a ck6000 readout, tested on 2 features x 2 datasets. As of 2026-11-10 ~12:50 UTC: 0 readouts exist; arms with a full train under way: debiased, queue16384, fnc, fullres (4); planned, not yet trained: mochi, tau_schedule (smoke only). Not counted as hypotheses: dino_native (stopped before any readout, duplicate of dino-ibot-v1), the fullres manifest alone. Final count is reported at the close of each arm. Interval: the confirmatory rule has no interval; statistical review reports a paired bootstrap of the 3-seed mean separately, with its CI.
predeclaration.not_run: No seeds beyond 42/43/44. No further arms. ViT-L not touched.
